meta.note: Revision 182 adds Human Crossbow enemies 034-035 and rapier-wielding Human Pirates 036-037. Revision 232 gives both Human Crossbow variants a data-driven three-handoff burst and 2.5-second recovery cooldown. Revision 234 adds weapon-free Human Boxer enemy_038 using body_05/head_16. Revision 235 corrects Axethrowers 090-093 with open left hands and axe_copy spinning-projectile handoffs. Revision 236 preserves the final user-authored Axethrower 090-093 rig and animation refinements. Revision 348 gives Hobgoblins explosive musketMortar ammunition with Skeleton Caster damage and makes Porker, Crocker, and Ogre default to 1.5 enemy scale. Revision 349 sets Big Red Rocket blast radius to 2 wizard heights and Hobgoblin musketMortar blast radius to 3 wizard heights, gives the mortar the Big Red Rocket expanding blastwave presentation, and increases Raptor hunter run speed from 200 to 800 (4x). Revision 350 fixes the Hobgoblin runtime rig handoff so its musketMortar catalog default survives character combat-profile synchronization. Revision 352 makes deployed enemies inherit live catalog defaults, introduces animation-timed generic attack handoffs for melee and projectiles, and makes projectile spread, rotation, presentation, effects, and AoE data-driven.

enemy_002.label: Skeleton Caster
enemy_002.description: A hunter skeleton that pursues Ignatius across terrain and casts an obstacle-aware orb of undeath.

enemy_020.label: Bombing Bat
enemy_020.description: The retained bat enemy. It patrols a small area around its authored perch, activates only when Ignatius enters its normal awareness view, flies overhead, and drops atlas-authored rocks.

enemy_021.label: Blue Bombing Bat
enemy_021.description: A smaller two-thirds-scale blue variant of the retained bombing bat. It patrols a small area around its authored perch, activates only when Ignatius enters its normal awareness view, flies overhead, and drops atlas-authored rocks.

enemy_030.label: Human Raider
enemy_030.description: A modular human sword enemy using body_00/head_00 with the fully articulated split-limb rig and refined animation set.

enemy_031.label: Human Raider II
enemy_031.description: A modular human sword enemy using body_01/head_01 with an exact articulated copy of the refined sword animation set.

enemy_032.label: Human Knife Thrower
enemy_032.description: A blonde human knife thrower using body_02/head_02. He performs the user-authored articulated throwing motion and releases three non-spinning, point-first daggers in a +/-5 degree fan.

enemy_033.label: Human Knife Thrower II
enemy_033.description: A dark-haired human knife thrower using the fresh body_03/head_03 pair. He shares Enemy 032's user-authored articulated throw and releases three non-spinning, point-first daggers in a +/-5 degree fan.

enemy_034.label: Human Crossbow
enemy_034.description: Human Crossbow using the shared modular-human atlas. He raises a two-handed crossbow, fires three separately aimed fast bolts at 0.4-second intervals with compact recoil/recovery beats, then lowers the weapon and reloads.

enemy_035.label: Human Crossbow II
enemy_035.description: Human Crossbow II using the shared modular-human atlas. He raises a two-handed crossbow, fires three separately aimed fast bolts at 0.4-second intervals with compact recoil/recovery beats, then lowers the weapon and reloads.

enemy_036.label: Human Pirate
enemy_036.description: Human Pirate using the shared modular-human atlas and a rapier. He reuses the articulated Raider lunge and slash timing.

enemy_037.label: Human Pirate II
enemy_037.description: Human Pirate II using the shared modular-human atlas and a rapier. He reuses the articulated Raider lunge and slash timing.

enemy_038.label: Human Boxer
enemy_038.description: A weapon-free modular human using body_05/head_16. He closes to melee range and attacks with the articulated bare-knuckle swing.

enemy_040.label: Raptor
enemy_040.description: A fast ground-hunting raptor assembled from a parent-constrained articulated rig.

enemy_050.label: Snake
enemy_050.description: A low-slung articulated snake assembled from repeated pattern-matched overlapping sections. It uses an organic slither, a raised-head bite, and a dramatic belly-up death.

enemy_090.label: Greybeard Axethrower
enemy_090.description: Greybeard Axethrower using the corrected open left hand. He hurls one independently authored, rapidly spinning double-headed axe from the axe_copy handoff at 0.339 seconds.

enemy_091.label: Blackbeard Axethrower
enemy_091.description: Blackbeard Axethrower using the corrected open left hand. He hurls one independently authored, rapidly spinning double-headed axe from the axe_copy handoff at 0.339 seconds.

enemy_092.label: Redbeard Axethrower
enemy_092.description: Redbeard Axethrower using the corrected open left hand. He hurls one independently authored, rapidly spinning double-headed axe from the axe_copy handoff at 0.339 seconds.

enemy_093.label: Copperbeard Axethrower
enemy_093.description: Copperbeard Axethrower using the corrected open left hand. He hurls one independently authored, rapidly spinning double-headed axe from the axe_copy handoff at 0.339 seconds.

enemy_900.label: Training Dummy
enemy_900.description: A stationary training dummy that uses the ordinary enemy pipeline but never attacks or deals contact damage.
